serverInfo.name: repotruck
serverInfo.description: Repotruck Model Context Protocol server for GitHub repository management, cloning, and workspace orchestration.

tools.name: repotruck_list_workspaces
tools.description: Discover every registered workspace in repotruck.

tools.name: repotruck_workspace_status
tools.description: Get workspace preset, repository counts, aliases, and last sync timestamp.

tools.name: repotruck_list_repos
tools.description: List tracked repositories with their absolute filesystem paths and metadata.

tools.name: repotruck_search_repos
tools.description: Search repositories by owner, path, language, category, or alias.

tools.name: repotruck_resolve_repo
tools.description: Resolve an alias or owner/name to an absolute filesystem path.

tools.name: repotruck_agents_md
tools.description: Read the AGENTS.md workspace layout and rule map for coding agents.

tools.name: repotruck_status
tools.description: Check per-repository Git working tree health and upstream synchronization status.

tools.name: repotruck_sync
tools.description: Bulk-clone and update repositories with scope, concurrency, stash, and divergence options.

tools.name: repotruck_clone
tools.description: Clone or update a single repository into the workspace.

tools.name: repotruck_create
tools.description: Create a GitHub repository, optionally publishing from a local directory.

tools.name: repotruck_move
tools.description: Relocate a repository to a custom path and update aliases and AGENTS.md.

tools.name: repotruck_reorganize
tools.description: Re-file repositories according to a new preset layout.

tools.name: repotruck_forget
tools.description: Untrack a repository from the workspace while leaving disk files untouched.

tools.name: repotruck_delete
tools.description: Untrack a repository and delete its directory from disk (confirmation required).

tools.name: repotruck_prune
tools.description: Untrack repositories that have been deleted or archived on GitHub.

tools.name: repotruck_archive
tools.description: Archive a repository on GitHub and re-file it under the archived directory.

tools.name: repotruck_doctor
tools.description: Verify git, gh, GitHub token, central store, and workspace health.
